notes.subject: Kristy call notes — handwritten outreach history
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes list Cinco de Mayo in Denver and say to reach out in January. The current official event remains a very large family-friendly festival at Civic Center Park, with a specific vendor/exhibitor route. Preserve the note as an early-planning instruction rather than waiting until spring.

followUps.label: 2027 opportunity follow-up
followUps.reason: Kristy's sheet says to reach out in January. Verify 2027 dates/contact route and approach as a separate family-entertainment attraction.
